title: Model Settings - Rework 1
outcome_summary: This rework cycle successfully addressed all actionable technical debt, security hardening, and test-coverage gaps from the prior model-settings project. The primary achievements were: the server.ts route dispatch refactor (handleRequest() reduced from ~448 to 55 lines via a declarative BodyRoute table), config.js decomposition into three focused files (~1,395 to 181 lines), elimination of the info-disclosure error message in handleUpdateAssignments(), orchestrator glob widening for two-digit persona files, and 60 new unit tests. All 9 work packages completed with zero test failures and 3,593/3,593 tests passing; two Medium-priority UUID-reflection info-disclosure findings were identified and deferred for a targeted follow-on cycle.
project_summary: Refactor the GUI server and frontend code introduced by the model-settings project to improve maintainability, fix a security info-disclosure pattern, add client-side validation UX, future-proof the orchestrator's persona file discovery, and establish test coverage for previously untested GUI components. No new features — purely technical debt, security hardening, and test coverage.
